title: Before you buy dumbbells, do these 4 for two weeks
caption: Home workout without dumbbells: Reverse Lunge, Doorframe Row, Glute Bridge and Prone Y Raise, every day for two weeks. When all four feel easy, buying dumbbells makes sense. Save this before you buy anything.

overlays.text: Before you buy dumbbells, do these 4 for two weeks.

scenes.footer: Legs. You lift your whole body on every rep.

overlays.text: Reverse Lunge. 6 each side. Step one foot back, lower the knee, stand up.

scenes.footer: Back. Grip a solid frame. The lean sets how hard it is.

overlays.text: Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull your chest in.

scenes.footer: Hips. The floor is all you need.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, push your hips up.

scenes.footer: Upper back. Just the floor and your own arms.

overlays.text: Prone Y Raise. 10 reps. Lie face down, arms in a Y, lift them off the floor.

scenes.footer: Easy means the last rep feels like the first. Then you know what you need.

overlays.text: When all four feel easy every day for two weeks, buying dumbbells makes sense.

scenes.footer: Save this before you buy anything.
